Sources: data/solutions.json (positioning, card, who it's for) and the client's TMC Product Overview PDF (description and 'Why we win'). Edit the text here, then run: python3 next/build-solution-pages-c.py

questbrand.Brand tracking: Always-on tracking of awareness, consideration and momentum, powered by the Harris Poll: a live read on brand health instead of a static quarterly tracker.
questbrand.Competitive benchmarking: See your numbers side by side with the competitors you name, across up to 24 markets, and spot where the gap is opening or closing.
questbrand.Campaign impact: Watch a campaign move the numbers while it is still running, so you can see what is working before the budget is spent.
questbrand.Emotional drivers: Go beyond awareness to the feelings behind it: what people associate with your brand, and how those associations change over time.

questdiy.AI-drafted surveys: Describe what you want to learn and AI drafts the questionnaire for you to edit. No agency brief, no weeks of back and forth.
questdiy.Respondents in 100+ countries: A built-in global panel fields your study in more than 100 countries, so national and multi-market research runs from one place.
questdiy.Concept & message testing: Put concepts, messages and ads in front of real consumers before launch and see which one lands.
questdiy.Same-day reads: Studies are built, fielded and analysed in as little as four hours, so the answer arrives before the deadline.

bera.Brand ROI tracking: Links brand performance directly to business outcomes, pricing power and revenue, so you can show which brand investments pay.
bera.Audience prioritization: Engagement-based segmentation separates loyals, switchers, prospects and win-backs, and shows which audiences are worth growing.
bera.Competitive intelligence: Weekly, census-matched tracking across 5,000+ brands benchmarks you against category rivals and everything else competing for attention.
bera.Media planning: More than ten years of historical data feed media mix modelling, quantifying brand impact alongside media, pricing and distribution.

knowledge_machine.Real-time sentiment across owned, earned: Emotional and market signals from your own channels, earned coverage and competitors, read together as they happen.
knowledge_machine.Historical pattern matching against prio: Each new signal is compared with earlier moments that looked like it, so you can see how similar shifts played out before.
knowledge_machine.Full audience profile surfaced with the: Every signal arrives with who is driving it, not just what is shifting, so the response can be aimed at the right people.

unicepta.Global monitoring: Connects 460M+ sources across news, social, broadcast and AI answers, in 187 languages, into one decision-ready view.
unicepta.Daily briefings & alerts: Curated daily media reviews and real-time alerts, shaped around what your brand needs to know.
unicepta.Narrative analysis: Analysts and AI look past the metrics to the narratives, positioning and reputational risks your stakeholders are forming.
unicepta.Social listening: Conversation across social platforms, tracked alongside media coverage, so reputation is read across every channel that shapes it.

imai.Creator discovery: Search a 400M+ creator database, then vet audiences and check for fraud before anyone is signed.
imai.Campaign management: Outreach, contracts, approvals and tracking through to ROI in one workflow, instead of spreadsheets and DMs.
imai.LLM visibility: See how AI search tools talk about your brand, and act on it from the same platform as your creator programs.
imai.UGC video ads: Produce AI-generated, UGC-style video ads from the same workspace as your creator campaigns.

smb_platform.Creator discovery: Find creators who fit your brand, without a dedicated influencer team.
smb_platform.Audience validation: Check that a creator's audience is real and matches the people you want to reach before you spend.
smb_platform.ROI tracking: See what each creator and campaign returned, so the next budget goes where it worked.
smb_platform.One dashboard: Listen, understand, execute and measure from one place, built for brands and agencies of 10 to 250 people.

geopulse.AI visibility intelligence: Tracks how ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and other AI systems mention and describe your brand, topic by topic, refreshed daily.
geopulse.Prompt optimization: Persona- and journey-based prompts reflect how real people ask, not generic keyword lists.
geopulse.Competitive benchmarking: See where AI answers recommend a rival instead of you, and on which topics.
geopulse.Content simulation: Test changes to your content before publishing, and see how they are likely to shift what AI says about you.

numetrix.Audience measurement: Measures who actually saw and visited, anchored in verified visitation behaviour rather than estimates.
numetrix.Brand lift & ad impact: Connects audience impressions with brand lift, so out-of-home and place-based media can be judged alongside CTV and TV.
numetrix.Location intelligence: Foot traffic and dwell-time trends show how people really move, and whether your advertising changed where they went.

media_machine.Scores every platform and channel agains: Every platform and channel is scored against evidence of what has worked, so spend starts from proof rather than habit.
media_machine.Drafts the plan and flighting: Drafts the media plan and flighting for your team to review and adjust, instead of starting from a blank spreadsheet.
media_machine.Models spend and projected lift: Models spend scenarios and the lift each one is projected to deliver, before a dollar goes live.

newintel.Pricing moves: See when competitors change their prices as it happens, not in next quarter's deck.
newintel.Hiring signals: New roles and teams show where a competitor is investing before they announce it.
newintel.Earned coverage: What the press is saying about your competitors, week by week.
newintel.Creator activity: Which creators your competitors are working with, and what they are posting.

search_plus.AI search representation: See how your brand is represented inside AI search tools today, and where the description falls short.
search_plus.Influence how AI recommends you: Shape the content and signals AI tools draw on, so your brand is recommended more often and more accurately.
search_plus.ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok: One program across the AI assistants people now ask first: ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Grok.

id_graph.First-party data onboarding: Bring your own customer data in and match it against 260 million US consumers and 123 million households.
id_graph.Third-party media data: Connect media data from outside partners to the same identity spine, so audiences reach the channels you buy.
id_graph.Proprietary consumer intelligence: Enrich audiences with Stagwell's own data, from BERA, the Harris Poll and The People Platform, on what people think and do.
id_graph.Privacy-safe activation: Build and activate audiences without exposing any individual's identity.
